lines.text: Walking down the street, I catch you in my eye
Heart starts racing, don’t know how or why
Your smile hits me like warm sunshine
Got me daydreaming all the time
Butterflies are dancing, feelings feel so new
Wonder if you notice what I’m going through
Sweet crush, yeah you got me hooked
Like candy on my lips, can’t get enough
You’re the flavor that I crave every day
Sweet crush, won’t you come my way
Notes in my locker, whispers in the hall
Hoping this feeling never fades at all
Eyes meet across the room, the spark ignites
You turn my ordinary days so right
Pulse is racing fast, can’t hide the thrill
This feeling’s real, got me standing still
Sweet crush, yeah you got me hooked
Like candy on my lips, can’t get enough
You’re the flavor that I crave every day
Sweet crush, won’t you come my way
Maybe someday you’ll see me too
Turn this little dream into something true
Sweet crush, yeah you got me hooked
Like candy on my lips, can’t get enough
You’re the flavor that I crave night and day
Sweet crush, please just stay
